caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, metallic urn or vase with a tall, narrow neck and a wide, rounded body standing on a circular base. The vessel is rendered in shades of silver and gold, with reflective, polished surfaces that show various tints of blue, purple, and gray. The body of the urn features intricate gold detailing, including floral patterns, symmetrical leaves, and starburst motifs. The neck is vertically ribbed with gold bands at the top and bottom. Two large, scrolling handles extend from the shoulder to the rim, each decorated with gold and green hues and swirling, filigree designs. The lid has raised relief decorations of flowers and leaves in gold, and it is topped with a greenish gold motif. The base is round and slightly flared, accented with a gold band at the bottom and top. The composition is centered on a plain, light background with no additional objects present.
title: Silver Vase of "Blue" Silver
